title: Hairfiller mini-site pilot — project map
scope: Improve the complete hair-filler mini-site on its existing platform. WordPress is expected but Joachim must confirm the mini-site URL and stack. Do not migrate platforms or change the main Sarasin Clinic website or Shopify webshop.

tasks.evidence: Four screenshots analysed; main website excluded; pink CTA deferred.
Only four image attachments were received. Please supply the recording.
41 source headings mapped; 40 patient gallery images retained; raw snapshot and hashes recorded.
All source topics have preview destinations. Unsupported efficacy figures, absolute claims and inconsistent protocols require clinical evidence and approval.
Original numbered clinic diagram replaces the AI scalp-area approximation; prices and 1/2/3 ml amounts retained.
Bricolage Grotesque, green/mint identity, rounded sections, mobile disclosures and current working interactions retained.
Two genuine general-clinic reviews, review-source link, all nine source video IDs, Instagram, BLIK and HLN links. No invented ratings or treatment-specific endorsements.

tasks.item: Blog structure and first three articles
tasks.evidence: Knowledge hub plus three original review drafts. WordPress draft import prepared; publication waits for approval.

tasks.item: Source authorship, references and informed consent
tasks.evidence: Clinic source, Karen's existing profile, source references and original consent PDF linked. No claim of medical approval of the new copy.
Semantic headings, crawlable HTML links, unique blog metadata, matching FAQ data, reserved image sizes, robots controls and review-only noindex safeguards.
Needs actual mini-site URL, WordPress access and chosen SEO plugin. Validate self-canonicals, sitemap, redirects, indexing and Search Console on that domain.
Optional isolated page-template plugin and Gutenberg HTML handoff; native blog posts imported as drafts. No activation, database or theme change has been made.

tasks.item: WordPress staging compatibility and regression tests
tasks.evidence: Need site URL, confirmed WordPress/PHP version, theme/builder, staging access, backups and approval. Local preview tests do not establish WordPress compatibility.
Default-denied adapter and event contract prepared. No GA4/GTM or advertising identifiers, tags or cookies installed. Booking clicks are intent, not confirmed bookings.

tasks.item: Booking attribution and actual conversion validation
tasks.evidence: Needs booking-system access, consent/CMP integration and a verified completion event or approved webhook. Cross-domain attribution is not verified.

tasks.item: SEA campaign plan and landing-page readiness
tasks.evidence: Search intent, landing targets, negative keywords and measurement gates specified. Budget, Ads access, medical-advertising policy approval and conversion verification are still required.
Current citrine remains provisional. Pink was mentioned as a possibility, not a final approved instruction.
Public clinic assets preserved with provenance; supplied zone reference used. Confirm reuse permissions/consent for the separate mini-site and supply any replacement originals.
Earlier Figma frames are not a complete mirror of the expanded mini-site. Final alignment follows agreed content, platform confirmation and clinical review.
Repeatable responsive, content-map, asset, FAQ, navigation, video, article, metadata and measurement-consent checks run locally and on the published preview.
Physical iPhone/Android and production Safari checks need real devices; Chromium viewport emulation is not a substitute.
Requires staging approval, backups, agreed domain, indexing/CMP configuration and deployment authority. No ranking, AI citation, booking or campaign-result claims are made before real measurement.

Real general-clinic reviews, source links, video library and media references without invented ratings.
Three review drafts; final WordPress routes must follow the existing site's permalink structure.
Consult-focused differences and questions, linking to the main comparison and booking.
Personal instructions, risks, follow-up and appropriate home care.
Causes, information to bring and when medical assessment takes priority.
phases: Joachim confirms mini-site URL/platform; Karen approves content direction and clinical reviewer.
Inventory existing theme/builder/SEO/CMP; backups; integrate without platform migration; migrate media and draft articles.
Resolve clinical claims, images and CTA approval; real-device, accessibility, performance, forms and tracking validation.
Joachim approves rollout and rollback; verify redirects, canonicals, sitemap, indexing and booking attribution.
First check at 2–4 weeks; SEO trend review around 8–12 weeks
Use actual data and iterate. These are observation windows, not a promise of rankings or parity with the main website.
access: Exact mini-site URL, confirmed CMS, staging URL and development approval
Least-privilege WordPress access; theme/builder, PHP and plugin inventory
Recent restorable backup, staging clone, deployment and rollback owner
Existing SEO plugin settings and read access to Search Console
GA4/GTM and consent-platform configuration; approved event and data-processing requirements
Booking-system completion mechanism and permission for cross-domain tests

Clinical reviewer, source studies, current tariffs, consent documents, media/photo usage permissions and final CTA choice
measurement: Establish baseline by page and channel before launch; annotate releases
Track organic impressions, clicks, CTR and query/landing-page trends in Search Console

Review mobile usability and Core Web Vitals using field data when available
